_comment: Project-scoped MCP servers for Claude Code. Loaded automatically when you run `claude` from this repo. Fill in the API keys below before they will start successfully. Do NOT commit real keys — use environment variables (see MCP_SETUP.md).

nanobanana._purpose: Generate images via Google Gemini 3 Flash Image (a.k.a. 'Nano Banana'). Use when you want Claude to produce real PNG/JPG assets — penguin scenes, brand mockups, poster art, etc.

figma._purpose: Read your Figma designs so Claude Code can build them into real apps. This is the MCP behind the @aiwithanushka 'designed by AI, built by AI' workflow.

memory._purpose: Persistent knowledge graph across sessions — remembers your brand, decisions, and project state between Claude Code runs.

filesystem._purpose: Lets Claude read/write files outside the immediate working directory (e.g., a shared assets folder, your Downloads).
